inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Education Outside of U.S.: 1 employee's file contained education documentation that has not been translated into English.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Education Outside of U.S. (26 TAC §746.1045)

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912): 5 staff files did not contain a pre-employment affidavit form. 1 was missing the notarized affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: 9 children's files evaluated were incomplete or missing the following information:    Completed Health Statement, Release Contact Information Emergency Contact Information, Authorization for Emergency Medical Treatment, Immunization Records
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup: While conducting a walkthrough It was observed that an infant had a bottle while they were sleeping.     Note: We observed the caregiver remove the bottle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup (26 TAC §746.2419(7))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: Bottles in the infant room were not labeled with the child's first name and last initial.    Note: The bottles were labeled during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: A food allergy plan was evaluated and was missing the parents signature.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers: During the inspection, a child was observed in the infant room with a pacifier that contained an attachment piece to their clothing.    Note: Discussed the risk of choking/strangulation with the provider.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers (26 TAC §746.2401(6))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: Documentation reviewed showed the exit time for fire drills at 5 minutes and 4 1/2 minutes when it should be under 3 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: Documentation reviewed for fire drills were missing the date the drills were conducted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: The monhtly maintenance checklists for April was not available for review upon request.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: As of today, the initial sanitation inspection still has not been conducted by the local health department.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Not Over Concrete or Asphalt: Loose fill material is intalled over concrete in the outdoor play area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Not Over Concrete or Asphalt (26 TAC §746.4907(b))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The operational policies were missing the the following information:  1. How and when parents will be notifiedof   policy changes.  2.  Your provisions to provide a comfortable place with an adult sized seat in your center or within a classroom that enables a mother to breastfeed her child.  3, Preventing and responding to abuse and neglect of children.  4. Information on vaccine-preventable diseases for employees.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §746.201(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Documentation that Crib Meets Applicable Federal Rules: During the inspection, cribs did not contain documentation that the cribs meet applicable federal rules.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Documentation that Crib Meets Applicable Federal Rules (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(9))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Swings - in Front and Rear: The use zone in front and rear of the swings is insufficient. An additional 4-7 feet is needed in the front and rear.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Swings - in Front and Rear (26 TAC §746.4807(a))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - in Front of Access and on Sides: The use zone in the front of a slide did not extend 6 feet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - in Front of Access and on Sides (26 TAC §746.4805(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The initial sanitation inspection has not been conducted by the local health department.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The initial fire inspection has not been conducted by the local Fire Marshal.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Essential Documentation: The emergency preparedness plan was missing the following information: Essential documentation including emegency contact information and authorization for emergency medical information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Essential Documentation (26 TAC §746.5202(3))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Designated Location Inside: The evacuation diagrams do not show the designated location inside for shelter in place.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Designated Location Inside (26 TAC §746.5207(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Swings - Not Attached to a Composite Structure: A swing set is attached to a composite structure which contains a slide.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Swings - Not Attached to a Composite Structure (26 TAC §746.4701(c))
